items.description: Cutting rations for those who could not contribute. The hollow eyes of the hungry follow {name} through every corridor.
items.title: The Ration Cut

items.description: Reducing food distribution below subsistence. {name} remembers every bowl they made smaller.
items.title: The Empty Bowls

items.description: Deliberately withholding food. The sound of hunger — a quiet, persistent thing — haunts {name}'s sleep.
items.title: The Starvation Order

items.description: Leaving a companion behind during an expedition. {name} still checks over their shoulder, expecting to see the face they abandoned.
items.title: The Abandoned

items.description: Abandoning someone who trusted {name}. Trust, once broken, leaves a scar on both sides.
items.title: The Betrayal of Trust

items.description: Turning away a stranger in need. {name} wonders if that person survived the night.
items.title: The Turned Back

items.description: Closing the hatch on desperate faces. {name} can still hear the knocking.
items.title: The Closed Hatch

items.description: Taking a life in cold judgment. {name} sees that face every time they close their eyes.
items.title: The Execution

items.description: Ending a life, even in necessity. {name} counts the names in the dark hours before dawn.
items.title: The Taking of Life

items.description: Pulling the trigger on another human being. The recoil leaves a bruise that never heals.
items.title: The Shot

items.description: Taking what wasn't offered. {name} hides the stolen goods and the shame in equal measure.
items.title: The Theft

items.description: Keeping more than a fair share while others go without. The excess weighs heavier than hunger.
items.title: The Hoard

items.description: Stripping a cache bare, leaving nothing for those who might follow. {name} knows they condemned someone.
items.title: The Empty Cache

items.description: A lie told to protect oneself at another's expense. The truth surfaces in {name}'s dreams.
items.title: The Lie

items.description: A deception that shifted burden onto the innocent. {name} avoids the eyes of those they deceived.
items.title: The Deception

items.description: A betrayal of someone who called {name} friend. The word 'friend' has tasted like ash ever since.
items.title: The Betrayal

items.description: Harsh words spoken in a moment of weakness. {name} wishes they could take them back.
items.title: The Harsh Word

items.description: A refusal that cost someone dearly. {name} replays the conversation, looking for a different answer.
items.title: The Refusal

items.description: Denying someone what they needed. The denial was logical at the time — now it just feels cruel.
items.title: The Denial

items.description: Sacrificing another to save the many. The math is sound; the heart rejects it completely.
items.title: The Sacrifice of Another

items.description: The locked cabinet still holds the vial that was deemed too valuable to dispense. {name} knows someone in the infirmary died counting the hours until the next dose.
items.title: The Last Dose

items.description: The trade crates were hauled away for ammunition and scrap. {name} stands in front of the ration pantry, staring at the dust rings where the flour bags sat.
items.title: Weight of the Crates

items.description: The radiation warning tape was peeled away before the tins were brought to the table. {name} watches the children eat, saying nothing about the grease pencil mark beneath the label.
items.title: Marked Unsafe

items.description: For one evening the stove burned hot enough to sleep without coats. {name} wakes to find black frost choking the hydroponics lines three rooms down.
items.title: One Warm Room

items.description: The surveillance monitor kept flickering after {name} cut the exterior intercom. In the morning, the snow outside the heavy outer door is disturbed and empty.
items.title: Closed Door

items.description: Their bunk was reassigned before the sheets went cold. {name} avoids looking at the tally marks carved into the timber post beside the mattress.
items.title: The Empty Bunk

items.description: The false floorboard sits flush with the subfloor. {name} looks away as an ally divides the remaining dried lentils into three equal, insufficient portions.
items.title: Behind the Panel

items.description: The grease pencil marker stays pinned to the sector map where the expedition turned around. {name} cannot bring themselves to wipe the glass clean.
items.title: Turned Back

items.description: The head count on the way back had one fewer name. Through the long corridor walk home, {name} kept listening for footsteps that never caught up.
items.title: One Less Footstep

items.description: The distress signal was still cycling when {name} switched off the receiver to conserve battery. The speaker clicks softly in the dark before going dead.
items.title: Radio Still Calling

items.description: The rifle was already dropped in the dirt when {name} pulled the trigger. What stays in memory is how slowly the empty hands drifted downward.
items.title: Hands Visible

items.description: The diversion drew the patrol away from the supply cache exactly as calculated. {name} got the team out alive, and that is the part that makes sleep impossible.
items.title: The Safer Route

items.description: The insignia on the jacket was new, but the voice across the barricade was not. {name} cleaned their weapon afterward without looking at the brass casing on the floor.
items.title: Known Face

items.description: The signed pact is still filed in the dispatch locker with {name}'s name on the seal. The people who honored it are no longer answering on the wire.
items.title: Terms Broken

items.description: The patrol only asked for a name once before handing over the supply voucher. {name} holds the canned meat in their palms, unable to open it.
items.title: Name Given

items.description: There is no one left alive to ask whether the last promise was kept. {name} carries the unfulfilled words like lead in their chest.
items.title: The Promise

items.description: The ampoule remains unbroken in the medical kit for a future emergency. {name} remembers the sound of breathing in the dark ward after the lantern went out.
items.title: Saved for Later

items.description: The triage tag marked priority by work output rather than blood loss. {name} wrote the numbers down with steady hands that now shake when holding a pen.
items.title: Useful Enough

items.description: The pantry shelves were scraped bare down to the wood shavings. {name} noticed the pencil height marks on the doorframe only after the rucksack was already zipped.
items.title: Nothing Left

items.description: They asked only once if there was another way before stepping into the irradiated conduit. {name} gave the order, and the shelter went quiet.
items.title: The Order Given
